description: Singleton settings row for manual payments — bKash/Nagad numbers, price, duration, instructions. Key is always 'settings' (unique index makes it a singleton).

fields.name: Key
fields.description: Always 'settings' — unique index makes the row a singleton

fields.name: BkashNumber
fields.description: bKash number shown on the Upgrade tab

fields.name: NagadNumber
fields.description: Nagad number shown on the Upgrade tab

fields.name: PriceAmount
fields.description: Pro price as a display string, e.g. 299

fields.name: DurationDays
fields.description: How many days one approved payment grants Pro, e.g. 365

fields.name: Instructions
fields.description: Payment instructions shown on the Upgrade tab
